triage_groups.title: Preserve conversation metadata edits
triage_groups.context: Apply queue: metadata drafts are lost on refresh, stale audience can overwrite canonical values, and metadata-only edits have no leave-page warning.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Store per-conversation dirty values for title/status/audience to address #1 and #2, then include those drafts in the navigation guard for #3.
triage_groups.why: One explicit metadata-buffer model separates unsaved local intent from refreshed server values; the navigation guard then uses that same state.

triage_groups.title: Keep long histories usable
triage_groups.context: Apply queue: aggregate history size blocks navigation, summary compaction loses the selected editing target, and allowed large inputs require many serial summary calls.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Restore metadata-only discovery in #4, pin the selected draft for #9, then introduce bounded independent summary concurrency for #10 while retaining source order.
triage_groups.why: Recovering access and selecting the correct draft precede reducing the wait for long-history processing.

requirements_completeness.assessment: The plan has no supported Requirements/Implementation Units sections or R/U IDs. Its shared contract and Independent units inform intent: implementation is present, with confirmed HTTP-status and selected-draft-context gaps (#5/#9); action-version provenance remains incomplete (#11). Live provider quality and Supabase checks remain explicitly pending release.
requirements_completeness.reverse_check: No additional unrequested behavior rule was established; visible bounds and owner-policy choices are covered by the plan.

residual_risks: Live Supabase access_settings schema, effective RLS/grants and external-reader dependencies remain unverified. The pending hardening migration assumes the existing key/JSONB/updated_at contract and has not been applied. Staging schema inspection, service-role checks and denied anonymous/authenticated direct access are release prerequisites (docs/communication-continuity.md:76).
testing_gaps: Live PostgreSQL/PostgREST CAS and privacy behavior remain unverified because this run has no service credentials. Injected fixtures and in-memory storage do not prove actual conditional JSONB revision updates, cross-instance conflict handling, lost-response retry, deletion or direct-client denial; verify these in an authorized staging release check (harness/tests/communication-integration.test.mjs:44-72; docs/communication-continuity.md:64).

Live configured-model Hebrew output, image/PDF transcription quality and resistance to instructions embedded in received/attachment/summary content remain unverified. Canonical-history guards and untrusted-data prompts are present, but synthetic provider tests establish contracts rather than educational quality or OCR accuracy (docs/communication-continuity.md:66-72).

The committed browser QA at 639c74c lacks TXT/DOCX selection-and-extraction exercises. Supplementary expanded QA reports both passed, but that harness expansion is outside the reviewed commit, so its regression coverage is not yet in the reviewed revision.
